user.title: Git repository
user.description: Install and update a custom integration from the release ZIPs of a GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo or Gitea repository.

data_description.url: Full URL incl. owner/repository, e.g. {example_self_hosted} or {example_github}
data_description.target_domain: Folder name under custom_components, e.g. linknlink
data_description.token: Only needed for private repositories (GitHub: also avoids the rate limit). Stored only in this entry.

data_description.install_now: custom_components/{domain} does not exist yet. Installs the latest release; a restart is required afterwards.

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The API rejected the token for {repository}. Enter a new token (empty: without token).

data_description.provider: Changing it re-runs detection for this provider only

error.invalid_domain: Only lowercase letters, digits and _ are allowed.
error.provider_mismatch: The selected Git provider does not answer as expected for this repository.
error.cannot_connect: The server is not reachable or timed out.
error.rate_limited: API rate limit reached. Try again later or enter a token.
error.repository_not_found: Repository not found. Private repositories need a valid token.

state.not_installed: Not installed yet. Updating installs this integration from the latest release for the first time.

restart_required.title: Restart required for {domain}
restart_required.description: {domain} {version} has been installed. Restart Home Assistant to load it.
